L9: ## boat: full text transcript
L10: 
L11: boat is the cheapest, most powerful sandbox for agents, built for agent factories. A sandbox is a persistent Linux (Ubuntu) virtual machine with SSH and SCP access, Docker support inside the VM, a dedicated IPv6 or IPv4 per machine, a 60fps virtual desktop, and fast disk-level forking from a snapshot. It is built for AI agents, for programmatic use, and for humans.
L12: ### Pre-configured in every sandbox
L13: 
L14: Docker, VS Code, Chrome, Ghostty, the GitHub CLI, Rust, Node.js, and Bun come pre-installed. sandboxes are full Ubuntu machines, so you can run any devtool, language, or workflow. Bring any agent: Claude Code, Codex, or OpenCode.
L15: ### Why boat
L16: 
L17:   * Designed for agents: a sandbox starts easily via a CLI built for agents, programmatic use, and humans.
L18:   * Ready to use: Docker, GitHub CLI, languages, and other devtools are pre-installed.
L19:   * Full machine capabilities: full Ubuntu machines that run any devtool, language, or workflow.
L20: ### Pricing
L21: Simple, honest pricing. Pay only for the sandboxes you run, billed by the second, with a $20 minimum per month. $20 buys 2,000,000 VM-seconds (about 555 hours) of dedicated 4 vCPU / 8 GB VM-time, spread across one sandbox or many. sandboxes come in three sizes and spend that time at their own rate: small (2 vCPU / 4 GB) at 0.5x, default (4 vCPU / 8 GB) at 1x, large (8 vCPU / 16 GB) at 2x, so a mixed fleet is just the sum of its parts.
L22: boat offers a 7-day free trial (25 compute hours), then plans from $20/mo. boat is the most affordable option compared with E2B, Daytona, Modal, Vercel Sandbox, Railway, and others. See the full comparison at 【0†https://boat.dev/compare】.
L23: ### Install the boat CLI
L24:

L26: ## Linux machines in the cloud,
L27: not local worktrees.
L28: 
L29: boxes.dev gives each agent a whole computer that’s already running your dev environment (a “devbox”), and a way to steer that agent from anywhere.
L30: 
L31: ### Full computers, not worktrees.
L32: 
L33: A real Linux box with its own filesystem, port forwarding to localhost, and your dev setup preinstalled.
L34: 
L35: ### Isolation by default.
L36: 
L37: A fresh cloud machine for every meaningful body of work. No resource constraints, no port juggling.
L38: ### Agents run while you’re away.
L39: 
L40: Close your laptop, go to bed, touch grass. Your agents keep working in the cloud.
L41: 
L42: ### Sleeping devboxes are free.
L43: 
L44: Idle boxes sleep automatically, so parallelism doesn’t turn into runaway costs.
L45:
